status: PROJECT PARAMETERS. These numbers are NOT POLARIS values and carry no physical or regulatory meaning.
what_these_numbers_are: A dimensionless penalty index this project uses to let a later navigation cost layer prefer one cell over another. IMO MSC.1/Circ.1519 defines RIO and three operational categories; it defines NO numeric penalty, weight or cost. The mapping from a POLARIS category to a number below is a design choice made by this team, tunable, and must be presented as such. Changing these values changes route preference and nothing else.
not_a_block: No value here may be infinite and none is a prohibition. POLARIS is 'not... a Go/No Go tool but... a decision support tool' (MSC.1/Circ.1519 section 1.4). A cell with the highest penalty is discouraged, never excluded; the master decides. An infinite or sentinel penalty would be a hard block wearing a number, and is rejected by the loader.
units: dimensionless penalty index, higher = less preferred

rationale.normal_operation: No POLARIS objection to this cell. Zero penalty means this layer adds nothing; other layers still apply.
rationale.elevated_operational_risk: Reachable only for PC1-PC7 ships (Table 1.1). Penalised but clearly preferred over special consideration.
rationale.operation_subject_to_special_considerati: The most severe POLARIS outcome. Heavily penalised, NEVER excluded.
rationale.indeterminate: The RIO interval crosses a Table 1.1 boundary, so no single category is defensible. Penalised at the severe end so uncertainty is not rewarded, while both endpoint classifications stay visible in the audit trail.
rationale.unknown: No defensible RIO at all (for example SA=98 with no sea-ice stage). Penalised at the severe end: consistent with unknown_policy in the SIGRID policy, where unknown is never permissive. It is still a penalty, not an exclusion.

branch_policy.note: The conservative and optimistic mappings are both penalised and both reported. Nothing downstream may read one without being able to see the other; collapsing them is a decision for the cost layer, made explicitly and with the pair still available.

limits.note: max_penalty exists so a typo cannot smuggle in a de-facto block; it is not a claim about scale.
